title: A gym cannot erase a member's details, though the data agreement says the gym handles erase requests
what: The admin app has no way to delete or blank out a member. Its list of record actions has undo for an import, a check-in and an expense, but nothing for a member. The gym server also refuses to delete any member, plan or receipt typed in by hand; only imported ones can be taken back. The data agreement tells the gym that when a member asks to erase their details, the gym handles it. So a gym that gets such a request has no tool to do it, and HQ has none either (already written for HQ).
expected: An owner can erase one member's personal details (name, mobile, photo and notes), keeping only what tax law needs from receipts, and the member is gone from every desk.
who: members who ask their gym to erase their details, and gym owners
fix_line: Add an owner-only erase-member action that blanks the person's details on the server and on every desk, and keeps receipts without the name.

title: A deleted record keeps all its details on the server for ever
what: When the panel deletes a record (an undone import of members and receipts, a check-in, an expense), the server only marks it deleted and keeps the whole record, with the member's name and mobile, hidden but in the database. The first version of this step blanked the record; a later version dropped that, and nothing cleans these rows later. So an owner who undoes a wrong import believes those people are gone, but their details stay on MettleUp's server and in its backups.
expected: A deleted record keeps only an empty marker (as the first version did), so nothing personal stays once the gym deletes it.
who: members whose records a gym deletes, mainly after an undone import
fix_line: Blank the record's details when it is marked deleted, and blank the ones already marked.

title: After a gym goes online, its old browser copy of every member stays on that computer for ever, even after sign out
what: When a gym kept in one browser is put online, the browser's own copy of the gym (all members, mobiles, plans, payments and check-ins) is moved aside under a dated name and is never deleted. Signing out clears the online copy but not this one. The privacy notice says signing a device out deletes the copy the admin app keeps on it. On a shared front-desk computer this full member list stays behind, unseen, after the gym has left or the staff member has gone.
expected: Once the records are safely online, the old browser copy is deleted (or at the latest on sign out), as the notice says.
who: members of gyms that started in one browser and then went online
how_often: every gym that went online from a browser-only gym
fix_line: Delete the set-aside browser copy once the upload is confirmed, or on sign out, and say so on screen.

title: Unsent desk work stays on a computer with no end date after the person is removed or signed out
what: New members, member changes, payments and check-ins made without internet wait on the device until they are sent. When the person is removed or signed out from another device, the device forgets its key and copy but keeps these waiting items, with members' names and mobiles, until someone from the same gym signs in there again, which may be never. The sign-out box says refused items stay, but the privacy notice says signing out deletes the device's copy, and a removed person's device is told nothing.
expected: The notice says unsent items stay on the device until sent, and they have an end (for example removed after a set time with a warning to the owner).
who: members whose details were typed at a desk while offline
how_often: rare: only when unsent items remain at removal or sign out
fix_line: Name unsent items in the privacy notice and give them an end date with a warning to the owner.

title: A removed staff member's name, mobile and every device they signed in on are kept for ever
what: Removing a person from the panel only stamps them as removed: their name and mobile stay in the staff list, and every sign-in they made (which device, when first and last seen) stays too. No clean-up ever deletes these. The privacy notice says sign-in records are kept 7 days, and has no line for how long a removed staff member's details are kept.
expected: A removed person's details and old sign-ins are deleted after a stated time (sign-ins after 7 days, as the notice says), and the notice says how long a removed staff member is kept.
how_often: every person removed from a gym
fix_line: Add a nightly clean-up for ended sign-ins and for removed staff after a stated time, and add that time to the notice.

items.reason: All 12 listed promises read in code. Kept: the 6-digit WhatsApp code works 10 minutes, 5 wrong tries (1-29, 1-21); staff payments refused over 31 days back and any date ahead (1-33); inbound check by one free WhatsApp message (1-19, 1-20, 1-27, 1-28, 1-30); keeps checking when back online (1-31); demo members are made up and stay in the browser (1-22, 1-23); updated-terms words show the version day (1-36). None broken for privacy.

Notice and consent: the owner accepts the terms and data agreement, owner only, again on each new version. Deletion duty: a gym cannot erase a member (01) and deleted records keep their details (02). Purpose: front desk sees only what its job needs. Breach timing and children: this area holds nothing for either.

The owner's MettleUp access list shows support windows, what was looked at and HQ actions. The server also sends direct database looks, but the panel drops that list and never shows it: already written.

Kept longer than said: the set-aside browser copy (03), unsent desk items after removal (04), removed staff and their sign-ins (05), deleted records' details on the server (02). The online saved copy is cleared on sign out and when the key stops working.

The area calls only the panel's own address and the gym server. WhatsApp: links open the person's own WhatsApp with the text typed in; the QR is drawn in the browser. The number check through Meta is in the notice. No AI, analytics, Health Connect, Google Health or Fitbit here.

Sign out and a dead key clear this device's online copy and branch keys. Not deleted: the set-aside browser copy (03), unsent items (04), a removed person (05), deleted records' details and their copies in backups (02); a member cannot be erased at all (01). A real gym or member delete was not run (live write).
